Felix Schmidt recently spearheaded a critical project for a logistics client, integrating real-time data streams from 12 disparate sources into a unified analytics platform. Using Apache Kafka for ingestion, AWS Redshift for storage, and Apache Spark for batch processing, he designed an ETL pipeline that reduced data latency from hours to minutes. His approach balanced technical precision with scalability, allowing the client to handle 50M+ events daily without infrastructure overhauling.  

As Felix’s manager at DataVantage, I’ve collaborated on cross-functional initiatives, including cloud migrations and data governance frameworks. His reliability in high-stakes environments is matched by a proactive mindset—he consistently identifies bottlenecks and proposes scalable solutions. For instance, he automated Terraform deployments for our AWS infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by 30% and reducing manual errors.  

Felix’s technical depth spans cloud ecosystems, with measurable impact on performance and cost optimization. He’s adept at leveraging Apache Airflow for orchestration, ensuring pipelines run with 99.9% uptime. His Python expertise shines in custom scripting for data validation, and his dbt workflows have streamlined reporting for multiple clients. Beyond skills, he’s a collaborative problem-solver who mentors junior engineers, fostering a culture of shared ownership.  

In summary, Felix combines technical rigor with strategic thinking, delivering results that align with both business goals and technical excellence. His ability to navigate complex systems while maintaining clarity under pressure makes him a rare asset.  

Felix is a strong candidate for roles requiring technical leadership and operational excellence. I’m confident he’ll add significant value to any team.
